checks_passed.what_was_verified: Every one of the 71 reaction_id values referenced by the 27 pathways resolves to a record in reactions.json, all 71 reactions are used by at least one pathway, and no reaction_id is duplicated. No dangling reference exists.

Recomputed every chain independently by following precursor_step backwards from each terminal step (a step named by no other step's precursor_step). That yields 25 chains; the 27 pathway records contain exactly those 25 step sequences plus the two scope patent duplicates. No chain is invented and none is dropped, and no precursor_step is unresolvable.

The two prior-art routes (DE19846792A1 on p02, CN200510030163.5 on p03) occupy two separate pathways, share no step with each other, and no step of either appears in any Claims, Summary, Preparation Routes, Example or scope patent pathway. Neither prior-art route was promoted to scope patent.

Checked every pathway for a step from the benzoic acid arm and a step from the direct enol ester arm coexisting. None does: Summary pathway 24 and both Preparation Routes Scheme pathways use only the acid arm, Summary pathway 23 and Preparation Routes Step 8/9 use only the direct arm, and Claims (vi) and (vi') are in separate records. The fork is not merged anywhere.
No pathway chains steps drawn from two different sections; the two scope patent records reuse Preparation Routes chains unchanged. No chain was assembled from adjacent worked examples on proximity.

Recomputed rule 9 for all 27 records from the step product_yield_pct values. Every value matches: null wherever any step lacks a yield (including Example 8, where only the terminal step reports 76.59 percent), and the single-step passthroughs 81.13, 67.57, 80.0, 71.63 and 64.67 are correct. No yield was substituted or averaged.

checks_passed.check: fidelity - overall_purity_pct and derivation of intermediates and product
checks_passed.what_was_verified: overall_purity_pct equals the terminal step's product_purity_pct in all 27 records; intermediates equals the ordered products of every step but the last in all 27; product equals the terminal step's product_name in all 27, including the null on Example 11.

No record and no step carries an id field. All pathway level scores and min_* counts and all_steps_atom_map_confident are null, and every step's enrichment field (scores, counts, atom_mapped_rxn, atom_map_confident, template_r0/r1/r2 and hashes, canonical_rxn, reactant_smiles, smiles_source, product_smiles, product_smiles_source) is null, as rule 13 requires. Every CompoundRef has smiles null.

All 27 records carry exactly one branching tag and one convergence tag, the correct chain_length:N, and the correct lcl bucket for their step count. Every tag string is a single lowercase snake_case ASCII category:value pair and no record has a duplicate tag.

Compared all 47 rule 11 fields of every pathway step against its reaction record. Every field is identical except compounds[] on the 12 reactions reported above. The flat temperature_c, time_h, atmosphere, pressure, reactor_type, concentration and room_temperature values are correctly derived from the conditions object as rule 11 specifies, not copied.
